unmapped_files.why: The pipeline's result: every gene's stability score, rank, section and expression statistics across all the datasets. No sample type holds a gene-stability ranking (A.GEX holds abundance matrices and differential results), and its datasets name no NExtSEEK sample to be its parent; see the README, stableexpression.

MultiQC's report and the Dash Plotly app (its code and a copy of the merged counts, design and gene summary): views of the results, not results. With no D.SEQ parent there is no row for Link_QC to land on.

All datasets' normalised (and imputed) counts as parquet, and the merged design: an expression matrix assembled from count tables and public datasets that name no NExtSEEK sample, so no parent resolves (G-6), and parquet is no A.GEX DataType yet.
Each input dataset at every step (downloaded, ID-renamed, sample-filtered, TPM or CPM normalised, quantile normalised), as parquet: intermediates of the merged matrix.
Expression Atlas and GEO accessions found, the g:Profiler or custom gene-ID mapping and gene metadata, and the gene lengths used for TPM: inputs and lookups the run assembled, not results.
Per-dataset zero, missing-value and skewness statistics, ID-mapping counts, and the reasons datasets or genes failed or were warned about: run diagnostics, shown in the MultiQC report.
